subset: experiment == E4_main; original column values preserved as text; columns unrelated to Fig6 omitted
objective_column: Recorded per-instance objective; never reconstructed from scale-wise metric means.
normalization: Each metric uses the same instance-specific Greedy-LPT reference, stored in normMakespan/normEnergy/normCost/normImbalance.

bootstrap.unit: 30 seed clusters, shared indices retaining all five fixed task scales and all seven methods
bootstrap.interval: pointwise 95% percentile interval of the mean

rounding: Source components and normalizers are rounded independently to eight decimals; weighted decomposition only matches separately stored F within that rounding precision.
